repo_notes.content: This repo is being modernized with devin-modernization-kit. Prioritize facts a modernization assessment needs: exact framework/library versions with file paths, how frontend assets are built and packaged into the Java build, REST endpoints, UI screens/routes, database schema source, and test coverage. Call out deprecated or end-of-life technologies explicitly.
repo_notes.author: modernization-kit

pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: Modules, runtime topology, request flow from browser to database, packaging (jar/war/ear) and app server

pages.title: Build and Toolchain
pages.purpose: Build tool, wrapper, plugins, Java level, frontend build chain, CI, with exact versions and file paths

pages.title: Backend
pages.purpose: Framework and version, configuration style (XML vs Java/auto-config), layers, notable libraries

pages.title: REST API and Controllers
pages.purpose: Every endpoint or controller route with method, path, request/response shape

pages.title: Data Model and Persistence
pages.purpose: Entities, schema and seed data sources, DB vendors/profiles, persistence technology, migrations tooling

pages.title: Frontend
pages.purpose: Framework and version, screens/routes, services calling the backend, asset build and packaging

pages.title: Testing
pages.purpose: Test types, frameworks and versions, what is and is not covered, how to run

pages.title: Dependencies and Risks
pages.purpose: Dependency inventory with versions, end-of-life components, known security-sensitive libraries
